class.name: BulletFactory2D
class.brief_description: The heart of the BlastBullets2D plugin. Use this node to spawn bullets.
class.description:
The factory does all the work in spawning bullets and configuring other plugin related options. Keep a reference of your [b]BulletFactory2D[/b] node throughout the lifetime of your game and call the functions you need.
For tutorials and usage examples: [url=https://www.youtube.com/@realnikich]YouTube Channel[/url] [url=https://github.com/nikoladevelops/godot-blast-bullets-2d]Official Repository Of BlastBullets2D[/url]
[b]This plugin is completely free and open source - created by [url=https://x.com/realNikich]realNikich[/url][/b] Support My Work [url=https://ko-fi.com/realnikich]Donate On Ko-fi[/url] [url=https://www.patreon.com/realnikich]Donate On Patreon[/url]

method.name: debug_get_active_attachments_amount
method.description: Get the amount of active [BulletAttachment2D] nodes.

method.name: debug_get_active_bullets_amount
method.description: Get the amount of active bullet multimeshes of a specific type.

method.name: debug_get_attachments_pool_amount
method.description: Get the amount of [BulletAttachment2D] inside the object pool.

method.name: debug_get_attachments_pool_info
method.description: Get the whole information about the attachment object pool. Returns a [Dictionary] containing the scene path (or [code]"<in-memory>"[/code] for unsaved scenes) as the KEY and the amount of pooled attachments from that scene as the VALUE.

method.name: debug_get_bullets_pool_amount
method.description: Get the amount of bullet multimeshes of a specific type currently in the object pool.

method.name: debug_get_bullets_pool_info
method.description: Get the whole information about the bullet multimeshes object pool of a specific type. Returns a [Dictionary] containing [MultiMeshPoolKey2D] as the KEY (one per exact amount_bullets + shape bucket) and the amount of pooled multimeshes in that bucket as the VALUE.

method.name: debug_get_total_attachments_amount
method.description: Get the total amount of [BulletAttachment2D] in the scene tree.

method.name: debug_get_total_bullets_amount
method.description: Get the total amount of bullet multimeshes of a specific type in the scene tree.

method.name: free_active_bullets
method.description: Frees active bullets in the scene tree. Pass [code]null[/code] (default) to free all, or a [MultiMeshPoolKey2D] to free only that exact amount_bullets + shape bucket. Refused during the physics step (for example inside collision handlers); call it deferred then. Warning (shared factories): this frees live volleys from EVERY spawner using this factory (or bucket), not just yours.

method.name: free_attachments_pool
method.description: Completely frees the [BulletAttachment2D] object pool. To free only the attachments that came from one scene, use [method free_attachments_pool_for_scene].

method.name: free_attachments_pool_for_scene
method.description: Frees only the pooled [BulletAttachment2D] attachments that came from the given scene.

method.name: free_bullets_pool
method.description: Frees the object pool of a particular bullet type. Pass [code]null[/code] (default) to free the whole pool, or a [MultiMeshPoolKey2D] to free only that exact amount_bullets + shape bucket. Example: [code]MultiMeshPoolKey2D.make(200, PhysicsServer2D.SHAPE_CIRCLE)[/code]. Refused during the physics step; call it deferred then.

method.name: free_disabled_bullets
method.description: Frees disabled (pooled) bullets. Pass [code]null[/code] (default) to free all, or a [MultiMeshPoolKey2D] to free only that exact amount_bullets + shape bucket. Refused during the physics step; call it deferred then.

method.name: get_is_factory_busy
method.description: Sometimes the [b]BulletFactory2D[/b] might be busy doing some important work. This property provides an easy way to check if that's true.

method.name: get_is_tearing_down
method.description: Returns true once the factory started destroying itself. While true, teardown paths stop touching child nodes and most factory operations report an error instead of running.

method.name: get_physics_space
method.description: Get the physics world space in which the bullets interact.

method.name: helper_apply_side_spread
method.description: Deprecated: superseded by the outline_* tail params of the loop generators (deterministic placement/fill/shell). Kept bound for compatibility. Universal side pass for closed-outline patterns: returns a copy of transforms with each origin pushed along its own facing by spread * pow(rand, spread_exponent). On Path returns an identity copy; Outside/Inside push along/against the facing; Both picks a random side per bullet. Facings never change. Only meaningful for closed loops (Ring, Ellipse, Polygon, Star, Flower, Rose, Lissajous, Custom, and the shape generators above) — open layouts have no inside to push toward.

method.name: helper_apply_skip_indices
method.description: Drops slot indexes from a generated array (dodge doors, bullet text). Out-of-range entries are ignored with one warning; the output shrinks. The spawner applies this automatically via helper_skip_indices.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_aimed
method.description: Generates a fan of transforms aimed from the marker at [code]target_position[/code]. Same as [method helper_generate_transforms_fan] with the cone centered on the marker to target direction. Useful for aimed bursts and shotgun spreads that track a player. Returns an empty array if the target coincides with the marker.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_circle
method.description: Generates an exact circle outline: slots spread evenly around a radius loop centered on the marker, facing outward (or inward). The outline_* tail params place slots on the loop, fill its interior, or shell its outside.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_corridor
method.description: Generates a dense wall perpendicular to aim_direction with a carved center dodge door of gap_width pixels. spacing is reserved (unused): slots spread evenly across width (but spacing must still be finite and above zero, and gap_width narrower than width, or the call returns empty). Returns at most transforms_amount slots (the gap shrinks the array like Ellipse Wall). Combine with skip indices for multi-door variants. Used by the aimed trap preset.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_counter_spiral
method.description: Generates a twin counter-rotating galaxy: odd arms wind -angle_step while even arms wind +angle_step when mirrored (same facing switch as the multi spiral, including tangent-aware chirality). Turn mirroring off for a same-chirality multi spiral. Used by the twin spiral counter preset.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_cross
method.description: Generates a cross/plus barrage: arm_count rays of evenly spaced slots from the marker out to arm_length. Crossfire and plus-shaped danmaku bursts.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_diamond
method.description: Diamond (rhombus) perimeter from its diagonals, slots spread evenly by arc length, facing outward (or inward). Zero-area diamonds stack at the marker.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_ellipse
method.description: Generates a true ellipse ring with independent [code]radius_x[/code] / [code]radius_y[/code] semi-axes rotated by [code]ellipse_rotation[/code] (the ring helper's y_scale is only an approximation). Full draws every slot, Arc draws a spaced segment, Wall draws a dense arc with [code]gap_count[/code] carved dodge gaps of [code]gap_width[/code] radians each (danmaku walls with readable escape routes; the array shrinks to the surviving slots). Wall mode with gap_count 0 or gap_width 0 draws the plain arc (no carving). Facings follow the ellipse outward normal. Useful for oval bosses, stadium arenas and gap walls.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_fan
method.description: Generates a fan of transforms spread evenly across a cone. [code]direction_angle[/code] is the cone center relative to the marker rotation, [code]spread[/code] is the full cone width in radians, and [code]step_offset[/code] staggers origins along the direction so pellets do not stack on top of each other. A single bullet flies straight down the cone center. Set [code]centered[/code] to false for a one-sided fan opening from the center direction toward +spread. [code]angle_jitter[/code] adds per-slot random variance in radians for shotgun spreads (0 fires the exact cone). [code]seed[/code] drives the jitter (0 is non-deterministic). Useful for shotgun spreads.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_flower
method.description: Generates a floral spell-card pattern: [code]petals[/code] symmetric lobes around the marker, each holding [code]bullets_per_petal[/code] slots spread over [code]petal_spread[/code] radians. [code]petal_sharpness[/code] 0 gives round lobes, higher values pinch the waist into tighter flowers. [code]transforms_amount[/code] sizes the array (fewer slots than petals times per-petal truncates). [code]flower_type[/code] picks the bloom kind (0 FAN legacy, 1 RHODONEA, 2 PHYLLOTAXIS, 3 SPIROGRAPH, 4 SUPERFORMULA); [code]inner_radius_scale[/code], [code]spiro_roller[/code]/[code]spiro_pen[/code] and [code]super_lobes[/code]/[code]super_fullness[/code] tune the matching kind. Useful for boss blossoms and mandala rings.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_grid
method.description: Generates a grid of transforms that are positioned relative to the [code]marker_transform[/code]. [code]jitter[/code] scatters each origin by up to +-jitter pixels on both axes (0 disables it). [code]seed[/code] drives jitter and random rotation (0 is non-deterministic, otherwise reproducible).

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_heart
method.description: Generates a parametric heart outline (classic 16sin^3 curve) scaled by size. Boss love attacks and ending cards.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_lattice
method.description: Generates a staggered honeycomb lattice for honeycomb walls and geometric curtains.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_line
method.description: Generates transforms in a straight wall along [code]direction[/code], spaced evenly by [code]spacing[/code]. [code]anchor[/code] picks where the marker sits on the row (start, center, end). Bullets face along the line when [code]face_direction[/code] is true - plus 90 degrees when [code]perpendicular[/code] is set, for strafe walls - otherwise they keep the marker rotation. Useful for walls, curtains and gates. Returns an empty array when the direction is zero.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_lissajous
method.description: Generates figure-8 / weave openings: slots sweep t over the full turn on the lissajous curve (size_x * sin(freq_x * t + phase), size_y * sin(freq_y * t)) for crossing curtains with readable doors. Recipe: slow spin + lissajous weave = butterfly curtain.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_multispiral
method.description: Generates a multi-arm spiral: [code]arms[/code] interleaved arms around the marker (galaxy, windmill and rose looks at low bullet counts). [code]arm_index_stride[/code] 1 interleaves consecutive slots across arms, higher values group slots per arm. Same facing modes as the single spiral. Useful for pinwheels, galaxies and rotating boss arms.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_polygon
method.description: Generates a polygon perimeter (vertices corners on a radius circle from base_rotation), slots spread evenly by arc length, facing outward (or inward). The outline_* tail params place slots on the loop, fill its interior, or shell its outside.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_rain
method.description: Generates a rain curtain: slots spread along a horizontal band of [code]band_width[/code] facing [code]rain_direction[/code], with rows staggered by [code]drop_spacing[/code] so the curtain reads as layered sheets, plus random [code]jitter[/code] per slot. [code]seed[/code] drives the jitter (0 is non-deterministic). Useful for bullet-rain phases, storm walls and descending curtains.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_rectangle
method.description: Generates a rectangle perimeter walk (counter-clockwise from top-left), slots spread evenly by arc length, facing outward (or inward). Square = equal sides. The outline_* tail params place slots on the loop, fill its interior, or shell its outside.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_ring
method.description: Generates transforms placed evenly on a ring (or arc, when [code]arc[/code] is smaller than a full turn) around the marker. Every bullet faces outward, so art drawn facing right travels away from the center. Set [code]face_outward[/code] to false for implosion patterns that fly toward the center. [code]y_scale[/code] stretches the ring into an ellipse (facing stays radial, approximate on stretched rings) and [code]facing_offset_degrees[/code] twists every facing. [code]seed[/code] drives random rotation (0 is non-deterministic). Useful for radial bursts and boss rings.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_rose
method.description: Generates an exact rhodonea rose bloom: slots sweep theta over the full turn and sit at r = R * cos(k * theta) with k = petals. lobe_sharpness 1.0 is the exact rose (0 is round, higher pinches the waist). Recipe: Rose + phase_step_per_bullet + angular wobble = blossom finale. Used by the petal storm and blossom finale presets.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_scatter
method.description: Generates a biased-random burst: offsets fill the disc (or annulus, see below) with even density (not center-clumped). Use it for explosions, boss deaths and petal pops. [code]seed[/code] 0 is non-deterministic, otherwise reproducible — a seeded call returns bit-identical volleys every time. [code]inner_radius[/code] hollows the center into a ring (0 is a full disc; clamped to [code]burst_radius[/code]). [code]sector_direction[/code] centers a cone of [code]sector_arc[/code] radians for directional blasts and shotgun fans (TAU or more is a full circle; 0 or non-finite falls back to full circle). [code]facing_mode[/code] picks bullet facing: outward faces away from the marker, random faces anywhere, inward faces the marker (implosions); [code]facing_jitter[/code] twists outward/inward facings.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_spiral
method.description: Generates transforms along an expanding spiral around the marker. [code]facing_mode[/code] picks the bullet facing: tangent means each bullet flies along its travel direction on the spiral (the default), radial outward is the historical behavior, toward center faces the marker, keep marker preserves the marker rotation. [code]facing_offset_degrees[/code] twists every facing by a fixed amount. Useful for rotating emitter looks and volute patterns.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_star
method.description: Generates a true star shell: points alternating outer/inner vertices around the marker (distinct from the polygon helper's density bias). Boss star bursts and celebratory shells.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_star_polygon
method.description: Generates a star/polygon emphasis pattern: [code]vertices[/code] symmetric directions with extra density pulled toward each vertex. [code]vertex_bias[/code] 0 is an even ring, higher values sharpen the star. Useful for pentagram bosses, shuriken patterns and geometric spell cards.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_trapezoid
method.description: Isosceles trapezoid perimeter, slots spread evenly by arc length, facing outward (or inward). A zero top base degrades to a triangle; zero-area boxes stack at the marker.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_triangle
method.description: Triangle perimeter (equilateral circumradius, isosceles base + height apex-up, right X/Y legs recentered), slots spread evenly by arc length, facing outward (or inward). Degenerate triangles stack at the marker.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_waterfall
method.description: Generates a staggered waterfall curtain: columns by rows grid with per-row stagger offsets and jitter, firing along rain_direction. [code]seed[/code] drives the jitter (0 is non-deterministic). Past capacity the curtain keeps growing row by row instead of stacking. Combine with skip indices for readable doors.

method.name: helper_generate_transforms_wave
method.description: Generates a snake row along a sine wave of width, amplitude and wave count around the marker axis. Pairs with wobble flight for slithering curtains.

method.name: helper_sample_outline_circle
method.description: Circle loop track in marker-local pixels (adaptive density). Closed.

method.name: helper_sample_outline_counter_spiral
method.description: Mirrored-arm variant of the multispiral strips with INF separators (open).

method.name: helper_sample_outline_diamond
method.description: Diamond corners in marker-local pixels. Closed.

method.name: helper_sample_outline_ellipse
method.description: Ellipse sweep in marker-local pixels (adaptive density). Closed for full rings; wall mode draws its arc span in full (gaps read from the missing bullets).

method.name: helper_sample_outline_flower
method.description: Flower bloom track sampler in marker-local pixels mirroring [member helper_generate_transforms_flower] per-type math at a fixed density (closed loop). [code]flower_type[/code] selects the bloom kind (see [enum FlowerBloom]): FAN traces the petal-tip ring, RHODONEA and SPIROGRAPH and SUPERFORMULA trace their actual curve, PHYLLOTAXIS bounds the Vogel disc rim. Per-type knobs (spiro_roller, spiro_pen, super_lobes, super_fullness, inner_radius_scale) apply only to their matching bloom kind; unused knobs are ignored.

method.name: helper_sample_outline_grid
method.description: Grid row strips with INF separators between rows (open). Ideal structure only.

method.name: helper_sample_outline_heart
method.description: Parametric heart sweep. Closed.

method.name: helper_sample_outline_lattice
method.description: Lattice row strips with INF separators between rows (open).

method.name: helper_sample_outline_lissajous
method.description: Lissajous sweep in marker-local pixels. Closed.

method.name: helper_sample_outline_multispiral
method.description: One strip per arm with INF separators between arms (open).

method.name: helper_sample_outline_polygon
method.description: Polygon corners in marker-local pixels. Closed.

method.name: helper_sample_outline_rain
method.description: Rain row strips with INF separators between rows (open).

method.name: helper_sample_outline_rectangle
method.description: Rectangle corners in marker-local pixels, counter-clockwise from top-left. Closed.

method.name: helper_sample_outline_ring
method.description: Ring arc sweep in marker-local pixels (adaptive density). Closed for full TAU arcs.

method.name: helper_sample_outline_rose
method.description: Rose theta sweep in marker-local pixels (flips included, matching slot order). Closed.

method.name: helper_sample_outline_spiral
method.description: Spiral arm sweep (open).

method.name: helper_sample_outline_star
method.description: Star corners in marker-local pixels. Closed.

method.name: helper_sample_outline_trapezoid
method.description: Trapezoid corners in marker-local pixels. Closed.

method.name: helper_sample_outline_triangle
method.description: Triangle corners in marker-local pixels. Closed.

method.name: helper_sample_outline_waterfall
method.description: Waterfall row strips with INF separators between rows (open).

method.name: helper_sample_outline_wave
method.description: Sine center-line sweep (open).

method.name: populate_attachments_pool
method.description: Populates the attachments object pool. Ensure that the [code]attachment_scene[/code] contains an actual [BulletAttachment2D] scene where you attach other nodes - particles or anything else you could think of. Pooling is keyed by the scene itself, so every loader of the same scene shares one pool bucket.

method.name: populate_bullets_pool
method.description: Pre-creates [code]instance_count[/code] disabled multimeshes in one exact bucket. [code]key.amount_bullets[/code] is bullets per multimesh (must equal [code]multimesh_data[/code] transforms size); [code]instance_count[/code] is how many multimeshes to create. The [code]key[/code] is required and must match the bucket derived from [code]multimesh_data[/code] (amount_bullets + effective collision shape); mismatch aborts with an error and creates nothing. Example: [code]populate_bullets_pool(MultiMeshPoolKey2D.make(5, PhysicsServer2D.SHAPE_CIRCLE), data, 2)[/code] creates 2 multimeshes of 5 bullets each.

method.name: reactivate_multimesh_instance
method.description: Re-registers a pooled multimesh inside the factory's active set after one of its bullets was woken with enable_bullet() outside of a normal spawn. Does nothing when the multimesh is already active, when the factory is busy, or when the factory is tearing down. You normally never call this yourself, enable_bullet() already handles it.

method.name: reset
method.description: Resets the factory. Pass [code]null[/code] (default) for a full reset (all bullets, pools, and the full attachment pool). Pass a [MultiMeshPoolKey2D] to reset only that exact amount_bullets+shape bucket; unrelated pooled attachments are preserved. Refused during the physics step; call it deferred then. Warning (shared factories): this kills live volleys from EVERY spawner using this factory (or every spawner sharing the bucket, when keyed) - not just yours. Spawner trackers prune the dead ids on next read. Emits the [signal reset_finished] signal when complete.

method.name: set_physics_space
method.description: Sets the world physics space that the bullets interact in. Set it before spawning: it applies to subsequently spawned bullets, already spawned areas stay in their space. Invalid RIDs are rejected with an error.

method.name: set_use_physics_interpolation_runtime
method.description: Controls whether physics interpolation is enabled or not for all bullets controlled by the [b]BulletFactory2D[/b]. This method is supposed to be called during runtime, while the [method set_use_physics_interpolation_editor] method is supposed to be called in the editor.

method.name: spawn_block_bullets
method.description: Spawns [BlockBullets2D] - bullets that act as a block that travels in a single direction with the same speed. If there is already a multimesh available in the object pool (that matches the amount of transforms provided and the collision shape) then it gets re-used with the new data. These bullets can NOT be controlled individually, but they are more efficient performance wise.

method.name: spawn_controllable_directional_bullets
method.description:
Spawns DirectionalBullets2D that are meant to be controlled and edited. If there is a multimesh available in the object pool (that matches the amount of transforms provided and the collision shape) then it gets re-used with the new data. Use if you want homing bullets or to edit properties during runtime.
Warning: Since object pooling is enabled by default, if you save these bullets to an array you might accidentally push the exact same multimesh (you end up with 2 references or more to the same exact object), that's why it's smart to disable auto pooling if you are storing them in arrays or other data structures - that way you can even implement your own pooling system.

method.name: spawn_directional_bullets
method.description: Spawns [DirectionalBullets2D] - bullets that have individual directions determined by the rotation of their transforms. If there is already a multimesh available in the object pool (that matches the amount of transforms provided and the collision shape) then it gets re-used with the new data. To control these bullets individually, use the [method spawn_controllable_directional_bullets] function instead.

method.name: teleport_shift_all_bullets
method.description: Shifts all bullets in the scene by a certain amount (only bullets spawned by this particular [b]BulletFactory2D[/b]). Both [DirectionalBullets2D] volleys and [BlockBullets2D] volleys (shifted rigidly as a whole) are moved, with shape, attachment and interpolation state synced per bullet. Warning (shared factories): this moves EVERY spawner's live volleys at once - there is no per-spawner or per-bucket variant.

members.member: The color for the collision shapes of all [BlockBullets2D].
The color for the collision shapes of all [DirectionalBullets2D].
Whether the debugger of the collision shapes is enabled or not.

Use this if you want to pause processing of bullets - being able to stop bullets in place. Always use this instead of [code]set_process[/code]/[code]set_physics_process[/code]. While paused, physics callbacks are dropped instead of queued, so overlapping areas cannot accumulate a backlog (no resume hitch). Warning (shared factories): pausing stops EVERY spawner's bullets at once - there is no per-spawner pause.

Determines whether physics interpolation is enabled or not. The setter is for the editor only.
Instead always use [method set_use_physics_interpolation_runtime] if you are doing changes during runtime.

signal.name: block_area_entered
signal.description: Emitted synchronously in the physics tick when a block bullet enters a physics area. Same handler contract as [signal directional_area_entered].

signal.name: block_body_entered
signal.description: Emitted synchronously in the physics tick when a block bullet enters a physics body. Same handler contract as [signal directional_body_entered].

signal.name: block_life_time_over
signal.description: Emitted (deferred, outside the physics step) when a block bullet multimesh's lifetime is over, but only if the [MultiMeshBulletsData2D]'s [member MultiMeshBulletsData2D.is_life_time_over_signal_enabled] is set to [code]true[/code].

signal.name: directional_area_entered
signal.description: Emitted synchronously in the physics tick when a directional bullet enters a physics area. Handlers run with live instance state (no casts needed); custom data and transforms are one instance call away (bullet_get_custom_data(), get_bullet_global_transform()). Only structural factory calls (reset/free_*/populate_*) must be deferred - the error message says so when it happens.

signal.name: directional_body_entered
signal.description:
Emitted synchronously in the physics tick when a directional bullet enters a physics body.
Note: Static bodies can be detected by the bullets, but only if you set the [MultiMeshBulletsData2D]'s [member MultiMeshBulletsData2D.monitorable] property to [code]true[/code] when spawning bullets - this is at the cost of performance of course, so it's better to stick with [Area2D] or other types of bodies for enemies/buildings etc and leave the [member MultiMeshBulletsData2D.monitorable] property to be false.

signal.name: directional_life_time_over
signal.description: Emitted (deferred, outside the physics step) when a directional bullet multimesh's lifetime is over, but only if the [MultiMeshBulletsData2D]'s [member MultiMeshBulletsData2D.is_life_time_over_signal_enabled] is set to [code]true[/code].

signal.name: reset_finished
signal.description: Emitted when the [method reset] method finishes.
